dct_description_sm:
Ontario is divided into 4 Bait Management Zones (BMZs) that regulate the movement, possession and use of baitfish and leeches:

  • Southern BMZ
  • Central BMZ
  • Northeastern BMZ
  • Northwestern BMZ

In portions of the far north, using or possessing live baitfish is prohibited, but these areas are not considered BMZs.

Learn more about Sustainable bait management in Ontario.
